transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having a hard time keeping my mind on things. At work, I’ll be looking at a loan worksheet or a client follow-up list, and I’ll realize I’ve read the same line over and over and still haven’t taken it in. Then I put off making calls because even simple decisions feel harder than they should.
Have you noticed that you're not enjoying things that you normally find pleasurable, or that you've lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to that specifically. I still do some of the usual things, but I guess I can’t say if I’m enjoying them less or if I’m just distracted.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or like you don’t have much energy lately?

Yes. I wake up tired even if I’ve slept through the night. And lately it doesn’t take much—after a couple of client calls, or even just watering the tomatoes, I feel like I’ve already put in a full day.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yes. Most days I have this dull heaviness with me. Even when I’m somewhere I usually like, like the community center or out in my garden, I feel like I’m just going through the motions and putting on a smile.
How long have you been feeling this way — the heaviness, the tiredness, and having trouble focusing?
It’s been a little over two years now. It started after my close friend died, and I don’t feel like I’ve really gotten back to myself since then.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for two years or more?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had hard times before, like most people, but I don’t remember anything that went on this long before this.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over the past few months?
I haven’t really noticed a major change. My appetite comes and goes a bit, but my weight seems about the same as far as I can tell.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things you’ve done—or haven’t done—lately?
I don’t know… not really in a clear way. I get frustrated with myself sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling worthless or especially guilty about something specific.
Have you noticed any days where it was especially hard to think clearly or focus on tasks, even more than the usual difficulty you’ve described?

Yes. That’s actually a big part of why I came in. At work I’ll be looking at a loan worksheet or a follow-up list, and I’ll realize I’ve read the same line over and over and it’s still not sinking in. Then I put off making calls because even simple decisions feel harder than they should.
Can you think back to any periods in your life before this current two-year span when you might have felt down or struggled with your mood for a few weeks or more?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had rough stretches like anyone, but I can’t clearly point to a time before this where I felt down for weeks in a way that stands out to me. It’s kind of hard to separate out now.
Can you recall any times in your life when you felt back to your usual self for a couple of months or more between any periods of feeling down or struggling with your mood?
Not really. Since my close friend died a little over two years ago, I don’t think I’ve had a couple months where I felt back to my usual self. It’s been more or less ongoing since then.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident, even if it didn’t last very long?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember a time when I felt unusually high or overly confident like that. Not really me.

Before the death of your close friend two years ago, can you recall any distinct periods lasting at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning the way you normally would?
I can’t really recall anything that clear before then. I had stressful times, sure, but not a distinct couple of weeks where I was down or not functioning like normal in a way that stands out to me.
Before the death of your friend two years ago, was there ever a time when you felt completely back to your usual self for at least two months in a row?
Before she died, I think I was basically my usual self, yes. Since her death a little over two years ago, though, it’s just been going on.
Can you recall any time before this current period of two years, where you had at least two months in a row where you felt completely back to your usual self?
No, not really. This current stretch started after my close friend died a little over two years ago, and I haven’t felt completely back to my usual self for a couple months at a time since then.
